panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Comic book cover, heroic low-angle shot inside {{vault}}. Exactly four kids stand shoulder to shoulder at the bottom, looking up with determined smiles, left to right: {{theo}}; {{dev}}; {{maya}}; {{zara}}. Above their heads floats {{vex}}, glowing. Behind them towers {{ring}}. The top quarter is plain dark stone, empty.
panels.alt: Andre, Mateo and Keiko stand together at the bottom of a tall stone vault lit by brass lanterns, smiling up at VEX, the teal robot with one glowing golden eye, which hangs above them.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide establishing panel inside {{vault}}. A huge round brass vault door fills the center of the back wall. In the lower foreground, seen from behind, stand just two children side by side: {{theo}} and {{maya}}. {{vex}} floats in the upper right corner. The upper left is plain dark stone wall.
panels.alt: Seen from behind, Andre in his blue hoodie and Keiko in her red jacket face a huge round vault door in the lantern-lit stone vault, while VEX glows high on the wall to the right.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Moody panel looking down a narrow spiral stone staircase that descends into darkness, lit by one warm lantern. Near the bottom right of the stairs, {{glitch}} scurries down the steps, looking back over its shoulder and giggling. The top half of the image is dark shadowed stone.
panels.alt: Looking down a dark spiral stone staircase lit by one lantern, the scribbly teal glitch creature scurries down the steps, giggling over its shoulder.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Dramatic splash panel inside {{vault}}. {{ring}} fills the center of the panel, one of its cyan notches gone dark. On the upper right rim of the dial, {{glitch}} scribbles across the dial with a piece of chalk, leaving messy blank chalk streaks. {{vex}} hovers small near the bottom center. Dust and chalk sparks fly.
panels.alt: The second ring: a giant stone dial ringed with glowing cyan lights fills the vault wall. The scribbly glitch clings to its rim, chalking a wrong answer across it.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Close-up panel of {{dev}}, shown from the chest up in the lower half of the frame, grinning with huge excitement, eyes sparkling, fists raised, warm lantern light on his face. Behind him a softly blurred dark stone vault wall; the upper third of the frame is plain dark wall.
panels.alt: Close-up of Mateo, in his orange shirt, grinning with excitement with his fists raised.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. panels.alt: Close-up of Andre, in his blue hoodie, frowning and pointing up at the dial.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Panel inside {{vault}}. At the lower right {{dev}} holds up a glowing brass lantern.
panels.alt: Andre stands at the left, chalk in hand, beside a big blank chalkboard on an easel; Mateo waves at the board from the right under a glowing brass lantern.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Close-up panel of {{glitch}} in the lower half of the frame, leaning in with a smug know-it-all grin, one scribbly arm raised like a heckler, floating in a dark vault. The upper third of the frame is plain dark shadow.
panels.alt: Close-up of the glitch, a lumpy teal cloud creature with yellow eyes and coral eyebrows, flexing both arms with a smug, toothy grin.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. No people, only the robot. Panel of {{vex}} floating at the far right edge of the frame, its golden eye bright and attentive. The rest of the panel to the left is plain dark navy and teal shadow with faint hexagon light shapes, kept empty.
panels.alt: VEX, the small teal robot with one big golden eye, hovers in a soft glow at the edge of the dark panel.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Panel with {{dev}} at the far left edge, shown from the chest up, turning toward the viewer with a confident grin and a thumbs up, in a dark stone vault. The rest of the panel to the right is plain dark stone wall, kept empty.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Panel inside {{vault}}. {{ring}} at the top center, jammed, a puff of dust and sparks bursting from one of its notches. Below the dial hangs a wide blank dark brass plaque with an empty surface. {{zara}} stands at the lower left with her hands on her head, startled. {{theo}} stands at the lower right, calm, arms crossed.
panels.alt: The great dial is jammed: sparks spit from beside its hub. A dark brass plaque hangs beneath it. Layla throws up her hands in surprise on the left while Andre stands calmly on the right with his arms crossed.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Close-up panel of {{zara}}, shown from the chest up in the lower half of the frame, gritting her teeth while pushing hard against a heavy brass lever that will not move, sweat drop, warm lantern light. The upper third of the frame is plain dark stone wall.
panels.alt: Close-up of Layla, in her green sweatshirt, gritting her teeth as she twists a heavy brass handle on the dial that will not budge.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Close-up panel of {{theo}}, shown from the chest up in the lower half of the frame, one finger raised like a teacher making a point, calm knowing smile, cyan glow on his face. The upper third of the frame is plain dark stone wall.
panels.alt: Close-up of Andre, in his blue hoodie, holding up one finger with a calm, knowing smile.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Panel with {{theo}} at the far left edge, shown from the chest up, looking straight at the viewer with an encouraging smile and pointing at the viewer, in a dark stone vault. The rest of the panel to the right is plain dark stone wall, kept empty.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. No people, no faces. Close-up panel of a wide blank polished brass plate with four rivets, set into a dark blue stone wall, its whole face smooth and empty, lit by warm lantern light from the left, dust motes in the air.

panels.alt: Close-up of Andre, in his blue hoodie, holding up a stick of chalk that sparkles with chalk dust, calm and ready.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Panel with {{theo}} at the far left edge, shown from the chest up, holding a stick of chalk and glancing sideways with an annoyed eye-roll, in a dark stone vault. The rest of the panel to the right is plain dark stone wall, kept empty.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Chaotic splash panel: {{glitch}} large in the center, cackling, swinging chalk in both scribbly arms, messy blank chalk streaks and scratch marks all over a dark navy wall around it. {{maya}} in the lower left corner leans back in shock. {{dev}} in the lower right corner stands with arms crossed and an unimpressed smirk.
panels.alt: The glitch, huge and grinning, flexes in the middle of an explosion of chalk scribbles across the vault wall. Keiko, in her red jacket, stares in alarm on the left; Mateo, in his orange shirt, crosses his arms, unimpressed, on the right.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. No people, no creatures. Splash panel inside {{vault}}. {{ring}} at the top center has swung open, golden light pouring out from behind it down a short flight of wide stone steps. At the bottom of the steps stand two identical tall arched wooden doors side by side, one on the left and one on the right, each with a blank brass plate at eye level. Dust and golden sparks fly.
panels.alt: The great dial has swung open. Golden light pours through an open double door at the top of a short flight of stone steps, sparks scattering, and a second wooden door waits in a stone arch to the right. Each door wears a label.
